name: K-Board
summary: Single-port family whose application and bootloader both report as K-Board; bootloader state is distinguished by PID MSB = 1.

notes: K-Board's SysEx preamble parser (MIDI_sysex.c: CORE_SX_PACKET_PREAMBLE, in both K-Board_Firmware and K-Board_Bootloader - same shared lineage) stops reading as soon as the fixed 6-byte preamble is decoded, without regard for the 7-bit/8-bit decode's 7-byte group boundaries. Without a flush after the preamble, the first payload byte of a sendSyxFormattedMessage()-based command can land in the same decode group as the tail of the preamble and get silently dropped when the firmware resets its decode buffer right after dispatching.

Confirmed on hardware: firmware_tester --flush-after-preamble (or --device kboard, which reads this field) is required for SYX_CMD_TEST_MODE/SYX_CMD_BURST_MODE payloads to land correctly; without it the command is silently no-op'd, not rejected. See k-board-firmware's .buddy-project/kboard-perf-test-design.md §10.3 for the full investigation.
Requests a reboot into bootloader mode while the device still reports as K-Board.
Preferred current production K-Board firmware payload. Chunk-safe (-cs512) packaging.

Adds finalizeTareCapture(): a one-time +25% margin applied to the settled boot-time tare average for key/button/bend-pad sensors, capped at 2/3 of range, to reduce reported key over-sensitivity. Bench-validated on real hardware.

NOT a production release. Performance-test firmware variant (perf_test branch of k-board-firmware) that emits synthetic MIDI/SysEx traffic on command and disables physical key/bend-pad input, used to stress-test mimic_hub with up to 13 simultaneous K-Boards.
Version 9.0.1 is deliberately out of the normal release sequence so it's unmistakable in an ID reply. Select explicitly with --fw-version 9.0.1; never the implicit default.
See k-board-firmware's .buddy-project/kboard-perf-test-design.md for the full design and SYX_CMD_TEST_MODE/SYX_CMD_BURST_MODE command reference.
Bootloader uses the same reported product string as the application; confirm state via PID MSB = 1.
